toolchain_contract.deterministic_operations: integer and byte operations only; no floating-point value enters the deterministic payload

authorization.contract_hash_preimage: all bytes strictly between the unique start and end marker strings, including their surrounding newlines but excluding both marker strings

accepted_constraint_definitions.W0: Reviewed nonce-misuse-resistant AEAD is the external boundary; AEAD-only is the production baseline.
accepted_constraint_definitions.W1: Use one 256-bit / 32-byte security-bearing state rather than independent byte maps.
accepted_constraint_definitions.W2: Use 4x8 Rijndael geometry with byte j at row j mod 4 and column j div 4.
accepted_constraint_definitions.W3: Use 32 keyed 8-bit rotor bijections per round as the only nonlinear layer.
accepted_constraint_definitions.W4: Use keyed affine equivalents of the AES S-box so every rotor preserves exact DDT, LAT, and algebraic-degree bounds.
accepted_constraint_definitions.W5: Use Rijndael-256 row offsets 0,1,3,4 and a 4x4 MDS MixColumns layer for explicit cross-byte diffusion.
accepted_constraint_definitions.W6: Derive rotor selection, round masks, and tweak material from a keyed PRF over complete canonical context.
accepted_constraint_definitions.W7: Inject a 32-byte PRF-derived mask before round one and after every round.
accepted_constraint_definitions.W8: Encryption and decryption are deliberately different; reflector reciprocity is forbidden.
accepted_constraint_definitions.W9: Require a tableless/bitsliced rotor path or explicitly exclude physical-security claims.
accepted_constraint_definitions.W10: Test rounds 1 through 12 but select no production round count in this gate.
accepted_constraint_definitions.W11: Evolution is immutable, deterministic, preregistered, control-calibrated, holdout-graded, and human-promoted; deployed mutation is forbidden.
accepted_constraint_definitions.W12: Promotion requires a new identity, byte-exact spec, independent implementations and KATs, full attacks, protocol/hardware evidence, external review, and human claim review.

authorization.allowed: deterministic model, structural certificate, ablation, and attack-harness research

predecessor.inherited_result: No byte-local depth was security-selected; 1+1 affine-AES/full-counter remains attack-only and AEAD-only remains production baseline.

questions.text: Does the frozen rotor family preserve exact AES-S-box differential, linear, algebraic, and bijection properties for every sampled key and ID?
Do the MDS and row-shift certificates establish branch number 5, structural all-to-all byte reachability, and the 25-active-rotor four-round theorem premise?
Are the rotors load-bearing: does bypassing their nonlinearity make the complete 256-bit permutation affine while the candidate violates the recovered affine model?
Is diffusion load-bearing: does removing it restore 32 isolated byte lanes while the candidate reaches full structural byte reachability?
Does this structural gate justify any production round count or an advantage over fixed-AES-SPN and AEAD-only baselines?

non_claims: Passing this gate is not IND-CPA, IND-CCA, AEAD, PRP, PRF, or standalone-cipher security.

A single-trail bound does not cover differential clustering, integrals, algebraic, meet-in-the-middle, rebound, slide, invariant-subspace, related-key/tweak, multi-user, reset/reuse, or implementation attacks.
Structural dependency paths do not prove the absence of algebraic cancellation.
No security-bit value is computed or implied; E256 denotes the alphabet and state width only.
Avalanche and dependency results are diagnostics, not confidentiality evidence.
The rotor namespace is not assumed to beat a fixed reviewed S-box; that remains an open comparison.
Reviewed standard AEAD remains mandatory for real data and AEAD-only is a valid final outcome.
No C/H/N row, E256 finding, suite, profile, fixture, or release gate closes here.

byte_encodings.bit_numbering: bit i is byte floor(i/8), mask 1 << (i mod 8); bit 0 is the LSB of byte 0
byte_encodings.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true and separators=(',', ':'); integers only in deterministic numeric results
byte_encodings.spectrum_serialization: DDT as row-major little-endian uint16; LAT as row-major little-endian int16

experimental_kdf.status: model-only HMAC-SHA512 PRF; not a suite decision
experimental_kdf.purpose_stream: concatenate HMAC-SHA512(PRK_subkey, domain || 0x00 || u64be(chunk_index)) for chunk_index=0,1,...; reject before chunk_index wrap
experimental_kdf.bounded_sampler: limit=65536-(65536 mod upper); read u16be v until v<limit; return v mod upper; require 1<=upper<=65536

canonical_context.encoding: prefix || field(UTF8 corpus) || field(opaque stream_id) || u8(direction) || u64be(sequence) || u64be(block_counter)
canonical_context.direction_semantics: traffic/channel direction held unchanged between permutation and inverse; not an encrypt/decrypt selector

rotor_derivation.matrix_rows: eight consecutive bytes become GF(2) rows 0 through 7; choose first attempt with rank 8
rotor_derivation.constants: PurposeStream(key, base || ASCII '/constants').read(2); byte 0 is c_in, byte 1 is c_out

execution_serialization.purpose_stream_chunk_range: chunk indices 0 through 18446744073709551615 are valid; after emitting chunk 18446744073709551615, reject before integer wrap if another chunk is requested

reciprocal_sandwich_control_stream.mask: read consecutive 32-byte values from one PurposeStream and use the first value that is not 32 zero bytes

execution_serialization.complete_round_material: 800 raw bytes with no tags or lengths: 384 rotor-ID bytes in round-major then lane-major order for rounds 1 through 12 and lanes 0 through 31, followed by 416 mask bytes in mask-index-major then byte-index order for masks 0 through 12 and bytes 0 through 31
execution_serialization.rotor_table_record: 512 raw bytes with no tags or lengths: 256 forward bytes in input order followed by 256 inverse bytes in input order
execution_serialization.rotor_namespace: 131072 raw bytes with no tags or lengths: rotor_table_record in logical-ID order 0 through 255
execution_serialization.key_bit_flip_material: 131872 raw bytes with no tags or lengths: rotor_namespace followed by complete_round_material
execution_serialization.digest_rule: all material and namespace digests are lowercase SHA-256 hex of the exact raw serialization above
execution_serialization.duplicate_table_count: 256 minus the number of distinct rotor_table_record SHA-256 digests in the key-label-0 namespace

rotor_inverse_validation.logical_ids: 0 through 255 for every listed key label
rotor_inverse_validation.check: forward and inverse are both 256-point bijections and inverse[forward[x]] = forward[inverse[x]] = x for every x

execution_serialization.rotor_id_repeat_count: over the frozen 55296-ID roundtrip traversal in canonical key-label, stream-index, direction, context-case, round, lane order, count every occurrence after the first occurrence of that logical ID; also emit the 256-entry occurrence histogram
execution_serialization.affine_holdout_attempts: attempt values 0 through 65535 are valid u16be values; fail closed if no admissible distinct holdout is found
execution_serialization.avalanche_histogram: a 257-element integer array whose array index is Hamming distance 0 through 256
execution_serialization.fixed_aes_material: derive and retain the same candidate selections and masks; fixed-AES permutation ignores selection bytes but uses the masks unchanged

construction.inverse_loop: for round r from R down to 1: xor mask[r], inverse MixColumns, inverse RowShift, inverse rotor layer r; after loop xor mask[0]

rotor_family.formula: R(x) = L_out(AES_SBOX(L_in(x) XOR c_in)) XOR c_out
rotor_family.matrix_convention: bit 0 is LSB; output bit r is parity(row_r AND x); matrix rows 0 through 7 are derived in order
rotor_family.quality_rejection: invertible affine wrappers only; no DDT/LAT/cycle cherry-picking

mix_columns.orientation: out[4*c+r] = XOR over k=0..3 of gf_mul(matrix[r][k], in[4*c+k])
mix_columns.inverse: compute by exact GF(2^8) Gaussian elimination and require matrix*inverse=inverse*matrix=identity
mix_columns.certificate: all 69 nonempty square minors are nonzero over GF(2^8), hence branch number 5

construction.round_masks: one 32-byte purpose-stream read for mask indices 0 through selected round count
construction.round_bijection_certificate: compositional only: all 32 rotors bijective, RowShift a byte permutation, MixColumns determinant nonzero, and XOR masks invertible; no 2^256 exhaustive claim

metric_definitions.maximum_absolute_lat: max absolute LAT[input_mask][output_mask] over input_mask 1..255 and output_mask 1..255
metric_definitions.algebraic_degree: maximum coordinate ANF degree; compute separately for forward and inverse maps
metric_definitions.dependency: boolean structural byte reachability propagated through lane-local rotors, ShiftRows permutation, and union at nonzero MixColumns coefficients; not a no-cancellation proof
metric_definitions.affine_model: f(0) is offset; column i is f(e_i) XOR f(0) for the 256 frozen basis vectors; predict by XORing selected columns and offset
metric_definitions.avalanche: diagnostic Hamming distance in 256 output bits between zero block and each one-bit input flip under identical key/context/round material

four_round_proof_obligations: all 69 MixColumns nonempty square minors are nonzero
for active source-column counts a=1,2,3,4, middle bundle cases record a+(5-a)=5
active source-column counts a>=5 satisfy the middle bound immediately
two outer MDS inequalities each contribute branch factor 5
theorem_targets.scope: single differential/linear trails only; no clustering or security claim

corpus.stream_id: first 16 bytes of SHA-256(ASCII 'E256-W/gate/stream/v1/' || u16be(key_label) || u8(stream_index))

roundtrip_cartesian_product.key_labels: all train and disjoint holdout labels

corpus.roundtrip_block: first 32 bytes of SHA-512(ASCII 'E256-W/gate/block/v1/' || field(canonical_context) || u16be(block_index))

affine_probe.basis_inputs: zero plus basis vectors e_0 through e_255 using frozen bit numbering
affine_probe.holdout_derivation: first 32 bytes of SHA-512(ASCII 'E256-W/gate/affine-holdout/v1/' || u16be(index) || u16be(attempt)); choose first value that is nonzero, not a power of two, and not previously selected

avalanche_probe.output: integer histogram with keys 0 through 256 for each key label and round; diagnostic only

context_material_separation.context_pair_product: all four key labels x two stream indices x two directions x seven required context pairs
context_material_separation.direction_pair_product: all four key labels x two stream indices x nine context cases
context_material_separation.material_scope: all rotor IDs for rounds 1 through 12 plus all round masks 0 through 12
context_material_separation.collision_rule: complete canonical material bytes equal across unequal frozen contexts

key_bit_flip_probe.mutation: flip the indexed bit in the 32-byte test IKM before extract
key_bit_flip_probe.material_scope: all 256 rotor tables plus rounds 1 through 12 selection and masks

corpus.rotor_id_repeat_scope: all selection IDs in the 144 roundtrip contexts for rounds 1 through 12 and lanes 0 through 31
corpus.rotor_namespace_digest_scope: all 256 forward and inverse rotor tables for key label 0

baselines.purpose: honest structural and implementation-cost comparator; this gate assumes no security advantage for keyed rotor selection

must not trigger the reciprocal two-query detector on every probe

baselines.purpose: mandatory production complexity and security-boundary baseline

planted_controls.mutation: inject identity rotor tables through the normal rotor-layer variant while retaining normal masks, RowShift, and MixColumns
inject identity RowShift and identity MixColumns through the normal dependency and permutation variants
planted_controls.detector: all 32 dependency rows remain singleton same-index lanes for rounds 1 through 12

planted_controls.mutation: replace MixColumns row 3 with row 2 before structural validation
planted_controls.adapter_exception: expected typed structural rejection occurs before inverse or permutation because no inverse exists
planted_controls.detector: zero determinant or minor and inverse unavailable

planted_controls.mutation: inject row offsets 0,0,0,0 through the normal dependency reachability routine
planted_controls.detector: full 32-byte structural dependency is not reached by round 12

planted_controls.mutation: adapter F(x)=A^-1(A(x) XOR m), where A is the normal four-round candidate under the frozen affine-probe context and m is the first nonzero 32-byte controls-domain stream value
planted_controls.adapter_exception: the wrapper deliberately recreates the predecessor topology outside the normal candidate round order
planted_controls.detector: F(F(x)) equals x for all 64 probes
planted_controls.null_calibration: normal candidate and fixed-AES four-round maps composed with themselves must each fail equality on at least one probe

before normal canonical encoding replace direction by u8 zero while retaining the field

cost_convention.candidate_per_round: 32 rotor evaluations, 64 non-unit GF(2^8) multiplications, 96 MixColumns XORs, and 32 round-mask XORs; plus initial 32 mask XORs per permutation
cost_convention.fixed_aes_per_round: 32 fixed AES-S-box evaluations with the same diffusion and mask costs
cost_convention.tableless_status: implementation path required later; not implemented or evidenced by this gate

hard_rejection_rules: Abort interpretation unless exact planted-control IDs execute through declared paths and every required result and null calibration passes.
Reject the construction if the architecture contract, preregistration, predecessor payload, AES S-box, toolchain contract, KDF domains, or operational fields drift.
Reject the construction if any sampled roundtrip, exhaustive rotor inverse, compositional round-bijection, or state-width check fails.
Reject the construction if any sampled rotor is non-bijective or differs from DDT maximum 4, LAT maximum 32, forward degree 7, or inverse degree 7 under the frozen metric definitions.
Reject the construction if any MixColumns square minor is zero, the matrix is non-invertible, or branch number 5 is uncertified.
Reject the structural interpretation if row dispersion fails, structural all-to-all byte reachability is not reached by round 3, or E256-W-WIDETRAIL-25-v1 is uncertified.
Reject the construction if candidate context material collides at any required counter pair, reset, direction, or pinned key-bit flip.

Reject the construction if the candidate matches the recovered affine model on all holdouts for any frozen affine-probe round or if it exhibits byte-lane isolation under the frozen dependency routine.
Do not select a production round count or claim security solely from structural certificates, avalanche, failed affine probes, or a single-trail bound.

interpretation.round_selection: No production round count may be selected. Report the earliest structural dependency-complete round and four-round trail certificate only.
interpretation.candidate_retention: Retain E256-W only as the next attack target if every hard structural gate and control passes.
interpretation.baseline_result: The fixed-AES-SPN comparator has the same structural bounds with less keyed machinery; AEAD-only remains the production baseline. This gate establishes no rotor-namespace security advantage.
interpretation.next_if_retained: Freeze reduced-round and full-round attack campaigns before any byte-exact suite specification.
